meta.name: Masterpiece: Secret Collectors
meta.blurb: Four collectors sell paintings in sealed-bid auctions against secret reserves, each guarding private values and a secret theme style.

steps.text: Bids by seat 1 to 4 (the seller's slot shows 0): {bids_shown}. KEPT: the high bid {high_bid} did not beat the reserve; seat {seller} keeps {lot} and pays a fee of {fee_paid} to the bank. Cash now: seat 1 {players[0].cash}, seat 2 {players[1].cash}, seat 3 {players[2].cash}, seat 4 {players[3].cash}.

value.calc: you.cash + sum([value_low, value_mid_low, value_mid_high, value_high][i] for n in you.paintings for i in [0, 1, 2, 3] if (n + '=' + value_labels[i]) in painting_values) + theme_bonus * count(n in ['P1-' + you.theme, 'P2-' + you.theme, 'P3-' + you.theme, 'P4-' + you.theme] for n in you.paintings)

rules:
MONEY: All amounts are in thousands of dollars. Bids and reserves are whole multiples of {bid_step}.

SETUP: Players sit in seats 1 to 4 in a fixed circle; the player to the left of seat p is seat p+1, and seat 4's left is seat 1. Each player starts with {starting_cash} cash; cash is always public. There are {num_styles} public styles: Red, Blue, Gold and Green. Each player receives {paintings_per_player} paintings, one of each style, with public names (for example 'P2-Gold'); who owns which painting and its style are always public. Each player is secretly given a different style as their collector theme and is told only their own; everyone knows the four themes are all different. Painting values are dealt from a shuffled pattern so that every player holds exactly one painting each worth {value_low}, {value_mid_low}, {value_mid_high} and {value_high}, and every style has exactly one painting of each of those values. Each player is told privately the values of their own four paintings. A painting's value is known only to players who have owned it.

ROUNDS: The game has {rounds} rounds. The seller in round r is seat ((r-1) mod 4) + 1, so each player sells {sales_per_player} times. Each round:
1. ANNOUNCE: The seller is named. If the seller owns no paintings, the lot choice, talk, bids and resolution are all skipped that round.
2. LOT CHOICE: The player to the seller's left chooses one painting from the seller's current collection. It is announced, with its style, as the lot.
3. TALK: Every player, seller included, writes one short message at the same moment without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Talk is not binding and may be false.
4. SEALED BIDS AND RESERVE: At the same moment, each non-seller submits a bid from {bid_min} up to their current cash, and the seller submits a secret reserve from {reserve_min} to {reserve_max}. Amounts are rounded down to a multiple of {bid_step}.
5. HIGH BID: Let B be the highest bid. A tie goes to the tied bidder nearest the seller going clockwise (the seller's left first).
6. RESOLVE: If B is greater than the reserve, the lot is SOLD: the high bidder pays B to the seller, takes the painting, and is told its value privately. If B is not greater than the reserve, the lot is KEPT by the seller and no money changes hands between players; in that case, if B is at least {fee_trigger_min_bid}, the seller pays a fee of {unsold_fee} to the bank (or all their cash if they have less), and that money leaves the game; if B is 0, no fee is paid.
7. ANNOUNCE: All bids, whether the lot was sold or kept, the money moved and every player's new cash are published. The reserve and the painting's value are NOT published.
8. A painting that was bought can be chosen as a lot again later, when its new owner is the seller.

SCORING: After round {rounds}, all values and themes are revealed. Each player's score = cash + the total value of the paintings they own + {theme_bonus} for each painting they own whose style is their own theme. The highest score wins. If several players tie for the highest score, the one among them with the most cash wins. Players still tied on both share the win (a draw).
